  [ -n "$job_id" ] || continue
  [ -z "${extra:-}" ] || exit 1
  case "$job_id" in *[!A-Za-z0-9._-]*) exit 1;; esac

  i=$((i + 1))
done

printf 'QUEUE_DRAINED_AFTER=%ss\n' "$i"
lpstat -W completed -o archive
